in_marathi.name: Chandradeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandradeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandradeep means 'Deep as the moon' or 'Moon's deep' in Sanskrit and Hindi. This name is derived from the combination of two words - 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Deep' meaning deep or vast. It is a beautiful name that evokes feelings of mystery, depth, and the enchanting allure of the night sky.
